name: Ruler slider with odometer
description: A ruler with a needle you slide through a numbered list of steps, writing the step to a variable, and an odometer that rolls the digits of the readouts that follow.

live.default: {n} of {steps} apps. {monthly} a month, {yearly} a year, {total} over {years} {yearsWord}.{cap}

propDocs.variable: Name of a number variable. The ruler writes the chosen step to it and follows it when something else changes it.
propDocs.breaks: Steps where the price rule changes. A fast drag stops at each one and its tick flashes.
propDocs.scale: Array of {at, text, edge}. at is a tick index from 0 to steps times sub. edge first or last keeps the label inside the ruler.
propDocs.tiers: Array of {at, text, edge} labels in mono caps. A label turns bright once the step reaches the break with the same index.
propDocs.liveVariables: Names of the dollar variables used for {monthly}, {yearly} and {total}.
propDocs.odometers: Array of {node, source, prefix, decimals, grouping, big}. node is the id of a native output node, source the variable to roll. The digits roll in a layer over the node and its own text hides. big draws the dollar sign and the cents small.

fallback: The ruler is a real range input on top of the drawn ticks, so it works from the keyboard and without animation. Readout nodes keep their native text when the component does not run. With reduced motion ticks, needle and digits jump with no transition.
